items.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
items.summary: AI coding agents are increasingly help developers fix bugs and build features largely on their own, but every interaction with their models consumes tokens. In each session, an agent sends instructions, tool descriptions, and session history to its model. Most efforts to reduce this cost focus on individual tasks.
